Question 3

```{r}
world$Age <- tolower(world$Age)
View(world)
```



```{r}

# Extract values
library(stringr)
world$Years <- as.numeric(str_extract(world$Age, "\\d*\\.?\\d+(?=\\s*(yrs|year|yr|y))"))
world$Months <- as.numeric(str_extract(world$Age, "\\d*\\.?\\d+(?=\\s*(months|mo|m|mths|M|ths))"))
world$Plain <- as.numeric(str_extract(world$Age, "^\\d*\\.?\\d+$"))

```

```{r}
# Use plain numbers as years if other values are missing
world$Years <- ifelse(is.na(world$Years), world$Plain, world$Years)

# Compute total months and divide by 12 to get age in years
library(dplyr)
world$Years[is.na(world$Years)] <- 0
world$Months[is.na(world$Months)] <- 0
world$Plain[is.na(world$Plain)] <- 0
world$Age <- round((world$Years * 12 + world$Months)/12,2)
world <- world %>% select(-Years, -Months, -Plain)
world

```

```{r}
#Grouping
world$Age_group <- ifelse(world$Age < 5, "Less than 5 years",
                  ifelse(world$Age < 15, "5-14 years",
                  ifelse(world$Age < 25, "15-24 years",
                  ifelse(world$Age < 50, "25-49 years",
                  ifelse(world$Age >= 50, "50 years and above","Not Given")))))
world
```

```{r}

#The most and less affected age group
library(ggplot2)
age_summary <- group_by(world, Age_group) %>%
  count(Age_group, sort = TRUE)
age_summary
ggplot(age_summary, aes(x = Age_group, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(title = "Cases by Age Group",
       x = "Age Group", y = "Number of Cases") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}

#Epidemic curve
# Adjust if format differs
library(lubridate)
world$OnsetDate <- dmy(world$`Date of onset`) 

```


```{r}

# Convert all to character (in case some are numbers)
world$`Date of onset` <- as.character(world$`Date of onset`)

# Identify numeric Excel-style dates
is_numeric_date <- grepl("^\\d+\\.?\\d*$", world$`Date of onset`)

# Create a new parsed date column
world$ParsedDate <- NA

# Convert Excel numeric dates
world$ParsedDate[is_numeric_date] <- as.Date(as.numeric(world$`Date of onset`[is_numeric_date]), origin = "1899-12-30")

# Convert normal date strings using dmy()
world$ParsedDate[!is_numeric_date] <- dmy(world$`Date of onset`[!is_numeric_date])
 world

```


```{r}

# Fix just those that failed earlier
is_failed <- is.na(world$ParsedDate) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{2}$", world$`Date of onset`)
world$ParsedDate[is_failed] <- mdy(world$`Date of onset`[is_failed])
world

```




```{r}
# Ensure date is in Date format
world$ParsedDate <- as.Date(world$ParsedDate)
# Create month and year columns
world <- world %>%
  mutate(Month = floor_date(ParsedDate, "month"),
         Year = year(ParsedDate))
monthly_cases <- world %>%
  count(Month)
yearly_cases <- world %>%
  count(Year)


monthly_cases <- monthly_cases %>%
  mutate(Group = "Monthly")

yearly_cases_line <- yearly_cases %>%
  mutate(Month = as.Date(paste0(Year, "-01-01")),
         Group = "Yearly")

# Combine both into one dataframe
combined <- bind_rows(monthly_cases, yearly_cases_line)

# Plot both trends in one graph
ggplot(combined, aes(x = Month, y = n, color = Group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Monthly and Yearly Trends of Cholera Cases",
       x = "Date", y = "Number of Cases", color = "Trend Level") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Monthly" = "steelblue", "Yearly" = "lightgreen")) +
  theme_minimal()
```
